## Objective

Classes K0 to K4 with ordering, ceilings and the rule that a record takes the highest class of its evidence.

## Scope

As stated in the objective and acceptance criteria; nothing beyond them.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Unclassified input resolves to K2
- [ ] K4 is never storable
- [ ] `highest()` returns the maximum
- [ ] a grant ceiling comparison is total and tested for every pair
- [ ] lowering a class is reported as needing tier 2

## Test requirements

Unit tests over all class pairs.
